question: What constitutes the root Kaula in relation to the eight attainments of powers?
premises: The attainment of siddhis is identified with the root Kaula.
The teaching is addressed to the fair-faced goddess.
inference: The attainment of the eight siddhis is declared to be the root Kaula.
uncertainties: The specific eight siddhis are not named in this verse and rely on prior context.
plain_english: And these eight, O fair-faced one, along with the attainment of the siddhis, constitute the root Kaula.
